title: Biochemical and Molecular Effects of Rutin on Oxidative and Inflammatory Pathways in the Heart and Aorta of Diesel Exhaust Particles-Induced Toxicity in Male Rats.
authors: Oluwayomi, Oluwafunso; Lawal, Akeem Olalekan; Akinjiyan, Moses Orimoloye; Ayoola, Abimbola Olawumi; Ojo, Aanuoluwapo Babatunde; Jimoh, Yomade Ayodeji
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨芦丁对柴油尾气颗粒诱导大鼠心血管毒性的抗氧化和抗炎作用，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Diesel exhaust particles (DEPs) are components of atmospheric particulate matter in urban areas and have been linked to cardiovascular dysfunction. Rutin, a phytochemical, has been shown to possess many biological activities. This research aims to reveal the biochemical and molecular effects of rutin on the methanol extract of diesel exhaust particle (mDEP)-induced cardiovascular toxicity in male rats. Thirty rats were divided into six groups (n = 5); some were exposed to 30 and 60 microg/kg mDEP, while other groups were prophylactically treated with rutin (25 mg/kg). Antioxidant markers (GR, SOD, GPx, and CAT) were assessed using standard procedures. Molecular docking of rutin with selected proteins was done using AutoDock Vina. The physicochemical and pharmacokinetics of rutin were also evaluated using SwissADME. Oxidative stress (Nrf2, HO-1, NF-kb) and inflammatory biomarkers (IL-8, TNF-alpha, IL-10) were investigated using RT-PCR in the heart and aorta of mDEP-exposed rats. Exposure to mDEP significantly (p < 0.001) downregulated Nrf2, HO-1, and IL-10, but upregulated the expressions of NF-kappaB, IL-8, and TNF-alpha in the hearts and aortas of experimental rats in comparison to the control. All these effects were reversed by rutin in pre-treated rats. Rutin increased the activities of GR, GPx, and CAT compared to the mDEP-induced untreated groups. Rutin exhibits strong binding affinities with Nrf2, HO-1, and IL-10. The study suggests that rutin may protect against DEP-induced cardiovascular toxicity through a mechanism involving modulation of the antioxidant and inflammatory pathways.
abstract_zh: 柴油机排放颗粒物（DEPs）是城市地区大气颗粒物的组成部分，并与心血管功能障碍相关。芦丁（rutin）是一种植物化学物质，已被证明具有多种生物活性。本研究旨在揭示芦丁对柴油机排放颗粒物甲醇提取物（mDEP）诱导的雄性大鼠心血管毒性的生化和分子效应。将30只大鼠分为六组（n = 5）；部分大鼠暴露于30和60微克/千克的mDEP，而其他组则用芦丁（25毫克/千克）进行预防性处理。使用标准程序评估抗氧化标志物（GR、SOD、GPx和CAT）。使用AutoDock Vina进行芦丁与选定蛋白质的分子对接。还使用SwissADME评估了芦丁的理化性质和药代动力学。通过RT-PCR检测mDEP暴露大鼠心脏和主动脉中的氧化应激（Nrf2、HO-1、NF-kb）和炎症生物标志物（IL-8、TNF-alpha、IL-10）。与对照组相比，mDEP暴露显著（p < 0.001）下调了实验大鼠心脏和主动脉中Nrf2、HO-1和IL-10的表达，但上调了NF-kappaB、IL-8和TNF-alpha的表达。在预处理大鼠中，芦丁逆转了所有这些效应。与mDEP诱导的未处理组相比，芦丁增加了GR、GPx和CAT的活性。芦丁与Nrf2、HO-1和IL-10表现出强结合亲和力。研究表明，芦丁可能通过涉及调节抗氧化和炎症通路的机制，保护免受DEP诱导的心血管毒性。
